name: NIFTY VIX Fix - Monthly 1000s
description: Williams VIX Fix on each option's own premium, on monthly-expiry strikes in multiples of 1000 (CE and PE). Buys when the VIX Fix crosses above the threshold under the maximum premium, pyramids up to 10 buys while the strike stays inside its Rs 1,00,000 capital limit, and sells the whole strike at the average entry plus the target %.
